name: Neo-brutalism
oneLiner: Loud, unapologetic blocks: thick black rules, hard offset shadows, flat saturated fills, and type that shouts the truth.

effects.sticker: rotate(-2deg) on featured labels and badges only

motion.reducedMotion: replace the press-down translation with a 2px shadow reduction

primary.base: height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-family: 'Space Grotesk', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 #101010

secondary.base: height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 #101010

default.base: background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 3px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 0 #101010

height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 14px; border: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500

display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-2deg)
display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--uiux-color-text); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent

do: Use a 2px black border and a hard offset box-shadow on every interactive surface; they are the signature.
Keep the palette to paper, ink, one saturated accent, and one alarm color.
Set headlines in an 800-weight grotesque, tight tracking, and near-1 line-height.
Let the press interaction move the element by the same distance as its shadow.
dont: Do not add blur, gradient fills, or soft shadows — hard edges are the whole point.
Do not use more than one accent color per view.
Do not use this style for forms where users could misread a playful error as a joke.
antiPatterns: Neo-brutalist chrome around a generic blue SaaS form — the two languages fight.
Sticker rotation applied to every element until the page looks scattered rather than loud.
Neon text on black with 2px borders: loudness without structure, unreadable at length.

notes: Hard shadows give no affordance by themselves: pair every shadow with a border and a visible focus ring.
Yellow accents need dark text; white on #FFD400 fails contrast everywhere.
The 2px borders also serve as button outlines, which keeps 3:1 non-text contrast for controls.
